title: Stock Market Today Live, November 4: Stock to buy today: Nuvama Wealth Management (₹1,866) – BUY - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Sensex Today, Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates - Find here all the live updates related to Sensex, Nifty, BSE, NSE, share prices and Indian stock markets for 4th November 2026.

The share price of Nuvama Wealth Management has been moving in a range for more than three months now. The stock has been stuck between ₹1,600 and ₹1,900 since August. Within this, the price has been moving up now and is coming closer to the upper end of the range.

The bias is positive to see a bullish breakout above ₹1,900 this time. Such a break can take Nuvama Wealth Management share price higher to ₹2,150 in the coming weeks.

Markets regulator SEBI has entered into a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with Digital India BHASHINI division to facilitate access to its services in regional languages.

The agreement, signed on Tuesday, will enable SEBI to use BHASHINI’s language translation APIs, models and tools, including automatic speech recognition, text-to-speech, machine translation and optical character recognition.

The collaboration will also facilitate the enhancement of BHASHINI’s language models with securities market-related terminology, SEBI said in a statement. - PTI

Nuvama Wealth Management stock targets ₹2,150 with a bullish setup; buy at ₹1,866, use dips to ₹1,820, and follow tight stop-losses.
